bundle.shortDescription: Automated job applications with a hard kill switch.
bundle.longDescription: ApplicantOS discovers job postings from supported ATS platforms, scores them against your preferences, generates a tailored resume and cover letter from a personal knowledge graph, applies automatically where it safely can, and escalates to manual review where it cannot. Two independent switches gate every real submission and both default closed.
